lines.en: Not so fast!

I'm better than to
fall for THAT!
You're busted!

One steel enema,
coming right up!

Is there a girl
in there?

I'm much stronger
than that, idiot!

You're a sneaky
little bastard!!

Your will is weak,
infidel!

Now you're making
me angry!

Perhaps you do have
some brawn!

Ugh! Where did
that come from?

That was entirely
uncalled for!
lines.ru:
Это было совершенно
ни к чему!

lines.en: Arrgh!!

Nnngh! Don't count
me out yet!

How did you connect
that attack?!

I have just begun
to fight!

It appears I'm losing
without honor!

You just got lucky,
maggot!

I've never felt pain
like this before!
lines.ru:
Такой боли
я ещё не знал!

lines.en:
I'll see you in
the next world.

You unscrupulous
pooter-pirate!
Grahhh!

You'll have to do
better than that!

You have the reflexes
of a drunk yak!

I don't take hits from
retarded soldiers!
lines.ru:
Я не пропускаю
удары от тупиц!

lines.en:
You're going to die,
infidel!

That should have
knocked you out!

That attack had your
name on it!
lines.ru:
На этом ударе было
твоё имя!

lines.en: Impossible!

Next time you shall
not be so lucky.
lines.ru:
В следующий раз так
не повезёт.

lines.en: Raaahh!

This isn't over yet,
infidel!

One way or another,
you will fail!
I shall stop you.
Surprised? Ha!

That was much too
easy, pig!
Not this time!

I hate it when
ATACs do that!

Bad move, you
festering pustule.

You won't be able to
repeat that, dog!

Fall before your
master, pig!

To the victor go the
spoils of war!

I shall conquer all
who oppose me!
lines.ru:
Я покорю всех, кто
против меня!

lines.en:
I was born to humble
vermin like you!
Grahh!
Eeeeeh-yaaah!

Step up for the
smackdown.

Evil shall never
stand before good!

I'm looking for an
act of contrition.

Turn back from your
evil ways!
Aaarghh!
Haaaaaa!

I pray that you've
made your peace.
I must humiliate you.
Sonic Blade!
What was that?!
